content: There seems to a trade-off between capturing semantics and syntax as in both LV-N and FT there is an accompanying decrease on the GSem tasks in exchange for gains on the GSyn and MSR tasks. Morphological segmentation in LV-M appears to favor syntax less strongly than do simple n-grams.
